title: What's new in v2.5.0
summary: Accounts, roles and per-site access, MFA and passkeys, SSO, and an audit log.

steps.title: Identity
steps.listLabel: Security that scales to your install
steps.body: **Settings - Identity** holds accounts, roles and per-site access. Most installs are one administrator and one password, and everything here is for when that stops being enough: add accounts as **Admin**, **Operator** or **Viewer**, grant each one the sites it should reach, and require MFA where it matters.

steps.title: Passkeys
steps.listLabel: Sign in with a passkey, or add a second factor
steps.body: Your own **Security** page, reachable from your name in the header. Register a **passkey** to sign in without typing a password, or set up an **authenticator app** and keep recovery codes. It is also where you change your own password and **sign out everywhere**.

steps.title: Audit Log
steps.listLabel: Every change recorded, with who and where
steps.body: Every change is recorded with the actor, the site, what was touched and whether it succeeded, and kept for a year. Filter by time, category, actor, site or outcome, open a row for the detail, and export what you filtered. This happens whether or not you set up any of the above.

steps.title: Managed SSH Key
steps.listLabel: Key-based SSH without touching the container
steps.body: **Generate** a keypair for this site in one click, or **upload** one you already have. The private half is encrypted and never leaves the server. On a Cloud Gateway, **Install on gateway** places it over the connection you already have, which is the one place UniFi Network cannot put a key for you.

steps.title: ISP Network
steps.listLabel: See which router each hop actually is
steps.body: Hops are named by the network they belong to, so a provider with several of them reads as the same name more than once. **Hover** a hop and it now shows what traceroute would: the address it answered on and its reverse-DNS name. The list is ordered by round trip time, so a later hop that answers faster sits higher.

steps.title: Sign-In
steps.listLabel: Sign in through your own identity provider
steps.body: Add an **OpenID Connect** or **SAML 2.0** provider and sign in through it, with the redirect and metadata URLs here to paste into the provider. **New users** decides whether an unknown account is created on first sign-in or has to exist here already. Roles are set on this side.

steps.title: Chart series filter
steps.listLabel: Isolate one line, and read the tooltip in the order the lines sit
steps.body: **Click** a chip to show that series on its own, click it again for all of them, and **Ctrl-click** to drop just one. The tooltip now lists every series in the order the lines actually sit on the plot, with a dot on each at the point you are reading, and a refresh no longer pulls it out from under you.
